providers.name: Google Cloud
providers.short_description: Certification preparation resources for Google Cloud roles.
providers.description:
Google Cloud certifications are organised by role rather than by product. The foundational track validates vocabulary and service awareness, the associate track validates day-to-day operations, and the professional track validates design judgement under real constraints -- cost, reliability, security and organisational policy.

The material below is written independently against the publicly published exam guides. It maps each objective onto concepts, hands-on practice and the courses on this platform that cover them.
providers.meta_description: Independent preparation guides, roadmaps and study resources for Google Cloud certifications, mapped to the published exam objectives.

certifications.name: Cloud Digital Leader
certifications.short_description: Explain the value of Google Cloud and how it addresses business challenges, with no hands-on experience required.
certifications.description:
The Cloud Digital Leader is Google Cloud's entry-level certification. It has no lab component: instead of testing whether you can configure a resource, it tests whether you can explain, in business terms, what Google Cloud does and why an organization would choose it.

That makes it the right starting point for people who work alongside engineers rather than as one -- managers, analysts, sales and support staff, and anyone early in a cloud career who wants the vocabulary before the hands-on certifications.
certifications.audience: Managers, analysts and anyone who works with cloud teams without configuring the cloud themselves.
certifications.recommended_experience: None required. Comfort with basic business and technology concepts is enough.
skills: Data and AI on Google Cloud

resources.title: Cloud Digital Leader study roadmap
resources.description: A five-week plan for a certification with no lab component.
resources.content:
## Principle

This exam is entirely conceptual: nothing is configured or built. The fastest path is repetition on *why* a product exists, not *how* to run it.

## Weeks 1-2

Learn Google Cloud's vocabulary and tour the core compute, storage and data products at a summary level.

## Weeks 3-4

Read customer case studies and connect each one to the products involved.

## Week 5

Drill scenario-style practice questions daily.

certifications.name: Generative AI Leader
certifications.short_description: Explain generative AI concepts and Google Cloud's generative AI offerings well enough to guide a business strategy.
certifications.description:
The Generative AI Leader certification is business-focused rather than hands-on: it tests whether you can reason about generative AI strategy, pick an appropriate Google Cloud product for a described use case, and speak sensibly about responsible and secure AI adoption. There is no coding or lab component.

It suits product managers, strategists and technical leaders who need to make or influence decisions about adopting generative AI without personally building the models.
certifications.audience: Product managers, strategists and leaders shaping a generative AI adoption plan.
certifications.recommended_experience: None required. Familiarity with basic AI and cloud concepts helps.

resources.description: A five-week plan built around concepts and product selection, not code.
resources.content:
## Principle

No lab work is tested here. The fastest path is fluency in generative AI vocabulary and Google Cloud's product lineup.

## Weeks 1-2

Learn the core concepts, then tour Vertex AI, Gemini and the pre-built AI APIs.

## Weeks 3-4

Study prompting, grounding and responsible AI practices.

## Week 5

Drill scenario-style practice questions daily.
